sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of Lightweight Ad-Monetized Mobile Games

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States of America (Amended 2023)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER-Plus) - Pacific Islands Forum States

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: RMI Revised Code Title 29 (Business Corporations Act 1990); Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2001 (P.L. 2001-41) as amended; Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act 2005 (RMI Criminal Code, Title 16); Registered Agents and Nominees Act 2010; Banking Commission Directives and Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Regulations 2021

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized passport copy of each director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the person's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (bank statement or utility bill dated within three months)
Corporate due diligence package for any corporate shareholder (certificate of incorporation, register of directors, UBO declaration)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registrar of the shareholder's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or licensed legal opinion confirming source of funds

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of each director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and RMI domestic consolidated sanctions list. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), including family members and close associates, must undergo enhanced due diligence, senior management approval, and continuous transaction monitoring. Adverse media and negative news checks are required pre-incorporation and periodically thereafter.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Business and Intellectual Property (BIP) Registry - online filing via licensed registered agents only
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in Latin characters using the English alphabet and must include a statutory corporate designator such as 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', or 'Ltd'. Non-English names must be transliterated into English script and rendered in a form acceptable to the Registrar. The name must not be misleading, offensive, or deceptively identical to an existing RMI registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the registered agent may file a written reconsideration request with the Registrar of Corporations within 14 days, including legal arguments and supporting evidence. If the rejection is affirmed, an administrative appeal may be lodged with the Office of the Attorney General within 21 days. A further appeal to the RMI High Court is available under Title 29 of the RMI Revised Code. Name reservations are renewable for one additional 30-day period upon payment of a prescribed renewal fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Fully permissible. Hyper-casual mobile gaming is a non-regulated digital activity; the registered agent's physical address in Majuro serves as the statutory registered office. No separate physical office or local employees are required for a non-resident tax-exempt Business Corporation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (~5% per annum) for registered-agent-only non-resident exempt entities; unannounced inspections are ordinarily reserved for cases involving suspected AML/CFT violations or regulatory complaints.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee under RMI Business Corporations Act fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of incorporation filing fee (standard authorized capital USD 50,000)
First-year annual registration fee for non-resident exempt company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RMI Ministry of Finance / Licensing and Revenue Office

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office service (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for professional registered agent service

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO due diligence and AML/CFT screening bundle (including PEP and sanctions checks)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed compliance vetting fee per client

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and consular legalization bundle for corporate and personal documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-document authentication tariff plus courier costs

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 2015 (as amended), Republic of the Marshall Islands — Article II: Filing Documents; Article IV: Directors and Officers; Article VI: Registered Agent and Registered Office
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Registrar, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Innovation, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Certificate of Incorporation issued thereafter)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; no escrow or bank deposit requirement. Shares may be issued at no par value, and paid-in capital may be zero at formation. Consideration for share issuance is fixed by the board and must be adequate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Articles of Incorporation of the Company, as filed with the Registrar of Corporations, are hereby ratified and adopted. RESOLVED, that the Bylaws presented to this Board are approved and adopted in accordance with the Business Corporations Act 2015. RESOLVED, that the issuance of the Company's ordinary shares to the subscribers named in the subscription ledger is approved, and the consideration recorded is accepted as fully paid. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company shall be maintained at the office of the registered agent in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands. RESOLVED, that the following individuals are elected as President, Secretary, and Treasurer of the Company, each to serve until their successors are elected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, RMI Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Innovation (via licensed Registered Agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name reservation request through the RMI e-Registry or the registered agent's secure filing channel. The proposed name must contain 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', or a distinctive abbreviation, and must not be deceptively similar to any existing domestic or foreign registered name. Pay the government name search fee and obtain a name availability certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File a second name reservation with an alternative name; no loss of priority if resubmitted within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate Registrar (through Registered Agent and notary public)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation under the Business Corporations Act 2015, setting out the corporate name, a general or unrestricted object clause covering digital game publishing, the initial registered office address, the registered agent name, the authorized share structure, the number of directors, and the absence of par value. Execute the Articles before a witness or notary public and obtain the registered agent's signed acceptance.
required_dossiers: Consent and acceptance of Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a deficiency notice, amend the affected Articles, re-execute them, and resubmit within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Innovation (or RMI e-Governance portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed Articles of Incorporation together with the registered agent's consent to the Registrar. Pay the official state filing fee of USD 300 by wire or licensed local bank transfer, and obtain the stamped receipt evidencing the filing date and application number.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Pay any outstanding deficiency fee or respond to the Registrar's Notice of Deficiency within 15 days. If not cured, the filing is automatically void and a new filing must be submitted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the Articles are examined and approved, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and assigns a corporation registration number. Verify the corporate name, registration number, registered office, and effective date shown on the certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request a corrected certificate through the Registrar's administrative correction form if any corporate particulars have been erroneously entered; no refiling fee applies if the registered office and agent remain unchanged.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Action, Registered Office Adoption and Appointment of Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding Board of Directors (assisted by Corporate Secretary and Registered Agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold an organizational meeting of the incorporators or board. Adopt the Bylaws, ratify the issuance of shares to subscribers, confirm the registered office and registered agent, and appoint the President, Secretary, and Treasurer. Record the minutes, issuer share certificates, and maintain the statutory records ledger at the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a quorum challenge or defective minutes arises, ratify the actions by unanimous written consent of the directors and place a short-form ratification minute in the corporate records ledger.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable — no manufacturing or industrial operations are physically undertaken in the Marshall Islands for ISIC 5820 software publishing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable — electronically published hyper-casual mobile games do not trigger an operating or manufacturing permit.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA), Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not Required / Exempt — non-physical software publishing activity with no industrial discharge, hazardous substances, or land-use alterations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or point-source emissions thresholds apply. If a local office is later established, only routine solid e-waste handling is relevant under the Environmental Protection Act and EPA Solid Waste Regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required for intangible digital publishing. Should a physical office be opened, a fire safety compliance certificate, building structural occupancy inspection, and workplace health clearance from the RMI competent occupational safety office will be obtained before staff occupation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Revenue and Taxation Division). The RMI does not maintain a public tax e-filing portal for non-resident tax-exempt business corporations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Not applicable. The RMI does not issue a general income-tax TIN, VAT ID, or income-tax registration to foreign entities. A non-resident Business Corporation obtains its sole corporate identifier from the Registrar of Corporations under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (MIRC Title 51); this identifier is used for corporate filing and annual government fee purposes. No VAT ID is obtainable because the RMI has no value-added tax. If the entity directly employs RMI residents, it must separately register as an employer with the Marshall Islands Social Security Administration and receive an employer registration number; this does not constitute an income-tax TIN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. RMI law does not provide a check-the-box, pass-through election, or hybrid-mismatch election. A Business Corporation is a distinct legal person classified as a corporation; non-resident status alone makes its foreign-source income exempt from RMI income tax. The RMI has not implemented OECD hybrid-mismatch rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None (no VAT, no GST, no general sales-and-use tax). The RMI imposes only customs import duties and excise-type duties at the border.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable. There is no indirect-tax registration threshold because no VAT, GST, or sales tax exists. Import duty is triggered by individual imports based on customs value and the applicable duty schedule; no economic-turnover threshold applies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Not applicable. The RMI has no electronic-invoicing mandate, no real-time fiscal clearance, no API-based tax reporting, and no digital stamping for receipts. Non-resident digital game publishers have no e-invoicing obligation to the RMI Ministry of Finance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. Because the RMI has no VAT or GST, there is no 0% export VAT rate to claim and no export VAT refund mechanism. Ad-mediated hyper-casual mobile game publishing services are outside the RMI indirect-tax net, and non-resident Business Corporations are not subject to RMI income tax on offshore gaming or advertising revenue. Export zero-rating substantiation is therefore legally irrelevant.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Not applicable - no export VAT zero-rating claim can be made in the RMI; therefore no customs export declaration, bill of lading, or inward remittance certificate is statutorily required for digital game publishing revenue.

If the same entity were to export physical gaming media from the RMI, RMI Customs would require a customs export declaration or entry, commercial invoice, and transport documentation; this relates to customs control, not to any VAT refund.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Not applicable to export zero-rating because the RMI provides no zero-rating refund and imposes no VAT clawback or late-repatriation penalty. The RMI does, however, retain general legal sanctions for false statements to the Registrar or fraudulent financial misrepresentation: registration may be rejected, suspended, or revoked, and other penalties under applicable RMI criminal law may apply. Since non-resident gaming publishers are outside the RMI tax base, no anti-avoidance VAT clawback exposure arises.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) does not operate a central bank or a standalone foreign exchange administration; monetary policy is effectively delegated to the United States Federal Reserve through the use of the U.S. dollar as legal tender. The prudential regulator for banking activities is the Banking Commissioner under the RMI Ministry of Finance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility. The U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender and local currency, so there are no exchange controls or convertibility restrictions on either the current account or the capital account. Profit remittances are unrestricted and there is no withholding tax for non-resident business corporations. All outward funds transfers are subject only to standard bank-level AML/KYC due diligence, including verification of ultimate beneficial owner and source of funds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. RMI law imposes no statutory requirement to surrender export proceeds, no prescribed timeline for repatriation, and no mandatory conversion ratio into local currency because the local currency is already the U.S. dollar. Foreign-currency export receipts may be retained, freely converted, or remitted subject to normal banking documentation standards and Financial Transactions Reporting Act compliance.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Moderate-High. Offshore fintech EMIs (e.g., Wise Business, Airwallex, or Mercury) may onboard a non-resident RMI Business Corporation with digital-only KYC, provided the entity delivers a full corporate pack including certificate of good standing, certificate of incumbency, register of directors, registered agent letter, and a business narrative describing the hyper-casual gaming monetization model. RMI has no domestic EMI licensing regime, and offshore EMIs generally treat Pacific jurisdictions as enhanced-risk; therefore, onboarding may require an additional compliance review. Such EMIs are suitable for daily liquidity and ad-network payouts, but a tier-1 SWIFT bank remains necessary for capital escrow and large-value treasury settlements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For RMI-licensed banks, physical presence is generally required for first-time account activation. At least one natural-person director or a designated officer with signatory authority must appear before the compliance officer in Majuro or Ebeye for an in-person interview. Remote interview is permitted only where the entity has an existing bank relationship or where an RMI registered agent certifies the identities of all principals and couriers the notarized corporate documents to the bank. For fintech EMIs, fully remote opening is permissible with enhanced digital identity verification and centralized source-of-funds declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency, micro-valued inbound payments from online advertising networks (AdMob, AppLovin) without a supporting contractual archive or documented revenue logic.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Ad network payout terms and transaction logs, platform-generated settlement reports, aggregated game revenue dashboard snapshot, executed digital distribution agreements, and a reconciliation certificate issued by a licensed accountant.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident Business Corporation with no substantive local workforce or physical office and a sole dependency on a corporate agent for RMI nexus.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of good standing, board resolution authorizing the non-resident treasury structure, registered office certificate, proof of economic substance through service agreements and third-party game publishing contracts, and an up-to-date audited financial statement (if applicable).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sudden large-value outward remittances to game developers or ad-tech vendors shortly after account opening, indicative of layering or attempted avoidance of transaction monitoring.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed vendor agreements with milestone provisions, tax invoices or debit notes, board-approved cross-border treasury policy, authorized signatory register, and a twelve-month projected funds-flow forecast.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections must be wired to the BC's USD-denominated operational account using SWIFT MT103 from the parent or investor bank. The narrative field must state the purpose code 'GDB' (General Business Development) or 'Capital Contribution' in accordance with the sending bank's purpose taxonomy, referencing 'Capital Contribution to MH_BC – Hyper-Casual Games Publishing'. The beneficiary bank requires a board resolution approving the capital call, a signed subscription instrument, a beneficial owner source-of-wealth questionnaire, and preliminary AML screening. No RMI central bank authority clearance is necessary because the sovereign does not impose capital controls.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for software licensing, user-acquisition spend, and ad-tech services should be executed through SWIFT MT103 wire transfers to the counterparty's operations account. Commercial documentary Letters of Credit may be used only for materials procurement, such as server hardware or submarine cable capacity, but are not standard for digital services. Recurring ad-network payouts and developer advances may be settled via ACH (within the U.S. clearing system) or priority MT103, provided that each disbursement is supported by an invoice or contract milestone and clears the bank's payment rule engine.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX Forwards (for freely convertible receivable currencies, executed under an ISDA master agreement with a licensed swap dealer)
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) (for restricted or difficult-to-convert currencies arising from emerging-market ad monetization)
Cross-Currency Interest Rate Swaps (for long-term multi-currency funding and asset-liability management)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of the date of incorporation each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of $200 per month; failure to file for three consecutive months allows administrative strike-off by the Registrar

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory audit for private non-resident business corporations unless licensed as a bank, trust company, insurance company, or public company; or if the articles of incorporation impose an audit requirement
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed local GAAP; IFRS or US GAAP commonly adopted for non-resident companies

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Registered agent must maintain a current register of beneficial owners and confirm its accuracy during each annual report filing; any share transfer or change in UBO must be reported immediately to the registered agent for amendment of the register

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: None; non-resident Business Corporations are wholly exempt from Marshall Islands income tax under the Business Corporations Act and the Income Tax Act, which imposes no tax on offshore income. No tax holidays are required because the baseline rate is zero.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Marshall Islands corporate income tax return exists. The only recurring statutory filing for a non-resident Business Corporation is the 'Annual Report of a Non-Resident Business Corporation' submitted through the Marshall Islands Corporate Registry online portal, operated by the Office of the Attorney General under the Business Corporations Act.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual report is due on the anniversary of incorporation. If the corporation adopts a non-calendar fiscal year, the report must be filed within six months after the close of that fiscal year. A 60-day grace period is applied before late penalties accrue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered corporate name, registration number, date of incorporation, and registered office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the name exactly as shown in the Certificate of Incorporation; provide the address of the licensed Marshall Islands registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 2 / Box B2: Directors and Officers
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal names, nationalities, and residential addresses of all current directors and executive officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors and officers are permitted; no Marshall Islands residency or work permit is required for holding board positions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 3 / Box C3: Share Capital Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorized and issued shares, par value, and aggregate consideration received for issued shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State capital in U.S. dollars; minimum capital is not required, and share capital may be expressed in any currency if USD is not used.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Affirmation that the corporation has not engaged in business within the Republic, owns no real property there, and is not a 'domestic corporation' under the Income Tax Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A false declaration is an offense punishable by fine and/or imprisonment; if the corporation has local activities, it must instead apply for a domestic business license and tax registration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual report filing attracts a monthly administrative late fee of USD 250 per full or partial month. If the report is not filed within 90 days after the deadline, the Registrar may administratively dissolve the company. Reinstatement requires payment of all outstanding fees, a reinstatement fee of USD 200, and the filing of every missed report. Criminal penalties apply to any officer who signs a false annual report.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%; the Marshall Islands imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by any business corporation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. The Republic of the Marshall Islands is not a party to any double taxation agreement (DTA) or comprehensive income tax treaty. No tax clearance certificate (TRC) or treaty relief procedure is recognized or administratively available. Non-resident shareholders receive dividends without issuance of any withholding tax form or TRC.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0%; both the statutory rate and any treaty rate are nil because the Marshall Islands does not subject interest, royalties, or technical service fees to withholding tax. There are no domestic withholding provisions applicable to payments to non-residents.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable; a non-resident Business Corporation is taxed at 0% and falls outside the Marshall Islands income tax base, so no local transfer pricing documentation threshold exists. For parent-jurisdiction compliance, a prudent multinational group should still prepare transfer pricing documentation under the OECD Guidelines, but no Marshall Islands Local File or Master File obligation arises.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable selectively under the Marshall Islands Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) 2019. An entity carrying on a 'relevant activity' (banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing/leasing, headquarters, holding company, distribution/service center, or IP holding) must demonstrate economic substance in the Marshall Islands. A non-resident company that holds foreign intellectual property for hyper-casual game publishing and receives passive advertising revenue may qualify as a pure equity/asset holding entity and satisfy the reduced substance requirements. However, IP holding entities must meet specific active business tests and cannot rely on passive royalty arrangements alone.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Exemption Abuse / Domestic Activity Without License
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using a non-resident Business Corporation to conduct active commercial operations within the Marshall Islands (e.g., opening a local office, employing local staff, or selling physical goods to Marshall Islands consumers) without domestic tax registration and a business license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The corporation is recharacterized as a taxable domestic entity retroactively. Local business privilege tax or gross revenue tax may be assessed on local revenue (up to 3%), plus a 10% understatement penalty and monthly interest of 1.5%. The business license may be revoked and the entity struck off.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly permit the corporation to misrepresent its non-resident status are jointly and severally liable for resulting corporate liabilities, may be fined up to USD 50,000, and may be prohibited from serving as directors of any Marshall Islands entity for up to five years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Marshall Islands Business Corporation that owns high-value game IP or advertising contracts but whose directors, management, and core income-generating activities are wholly outside the Marshall Islands, without satisfying the economic substance requirements under ESR 2019 for a holding or IP entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Registrar may strike the company off the register, impose a financial penalty of USD 10,000 to USD 50,000, and require disgorgement of any tax or registration benefits. In serious cases the entity may be dissolved and its assets vested in the Republic.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers may be personally fined up to USD 250,000 per offense and imprisoned for up to two years for knowingly filing false economic substance declarations. Directors' personal assets may be reached in civil recovery proceedings for restitution to the government.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsifying the annual report or using a shell Business Corporation to launder ad-network payouts obtained from programmatic ad fraud, illegal gambling, or deceptive billing, while submitting nil or misleading filings to evade beneficial ownership disclosure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Marshall Islands Crimes Act 2016 and the Anti-Money Laundering Regulations, money laundering carries a fine of up to USD 5 million or twice the value of the laundered property, whichever is greater, and imprisonment for up to 25 years. Fraudulent filings attract an additional fine of up to USD 100,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners face criminal liability, including imprisonment of up to 25 years, asset confiscation, travel bans, and exclusion orders. The corporate veil is pierced for fraudulent conduct, and directors may be ordered to make full civil restitution to victims and governmental agencies.
